tasks.name: 짧고 굵은 송곳니
tasks.description: 넓고 둥근 뿌리에서 짧은 촉으로 좁아지는 기본형
tasks.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, tiny pixel-art relic.
Asset: ONE design for a dragon-fang / dragon-tooth piercing relic in a Unity 2D fantasy roguelike.
Input 1 is a tooth ANATOMY reference only: a solid natural curved canine and thick root. Do not duplicate its silhouette exactly, and do not adopt its gray/white palette. Input 2 is STYLE AND COLOR reference: five approved fire-family relics. Create the specified new design while matching their clean thick outlines and sparse flat pixel clusters.
Make this an intentional 32x32 icon. Each logical pixel is a perfectly square block; large connected simple color planes, clean stepped silhouettes, minimal shading, no fine texture. Thick substantial fang, clearly visible broad base tapering to a curved sharp tip. Warm CREAM is the dominant continuous tooth face; orange/red identifies the root or grip and links it to the fire relics. A fang must read as solid enamel, not a flickering flame.
ONLY SIX opaque colors including outline: #363232 charcoal, #F1E9D4 warm cream enamel, #EECF5A yellow warm shadow, #E09656 orange, #E55C5C red, #A75064 muted red root shadow. Use all six in deliberate contiguous clusters, with red/orange concentrated near the base and cream dominating the fang. No gray, pure white, pink flesh or additional colors.
A TWO logical pixel charcoal outer outline. At least TWO transparent logical pixels on all sides INCLUDING outline. Logical object bounds x=2..29,y=2..29. Natural proportions; emphasize compact mass and readable curvature; no long thin shaft. Actual transparent background.
Exactly one isolated centered finished icon. No sheet, other objects, label, number, border, grid, scene or ground. No gore, gums, blood, skull, jaw, detached chips or floating sparks. No flame effects, glow, soft shadow, gradients, dithering, noise, glossy rendering, antialiasing, tiny engravings or detailed bands. The shape must remain clear at actual 32x32.

VARIANT 1 — SHORT THICK CANINE.
A single stubby natural dragon canine tooth, diagonal from broad rounded ROOT at upper right to curved point at lower left. The cream tooth is fat and gently convex with a broad clean face, one simple yellow side plane and a soft concave inner edge. The blunt root has a compact asymmetrical orange cap with a small red/muted-red underside; the root is the natural end of the tooth, not a manufactured handle. The curved pointed part is fairly short relative to its broad base. Strong, solid, almost wedge-like overall mass, gentle curve. No collar, grip or metal setting.
